Free online dating & matchmaking, worldwide

Torch is a free online dating app and matchmaking service that helps you meet singles worldwide. Whether you're looking for love, a serious relationship, or something casual, you can swipe, match and chat with men, women and LGBTQ+ singles near you — or in any country on earth.

Dating for everyone

Torch is for everyone. Straight, gay, lesbian, bisexual, pansexual, queer and asexual singles are all welcome. Choose your gender, your orientation, and exactly who you want to meet — locally or internationally.
